name: slicer-hub-js-clients
description: Slicer Hub browser clients and shared JS hub client

scripts.build: npm run build -w @slicer-hub/client && npm run build -w @slicer-hub/conference-ui && npm run build -w @slicer-hub/worklist && npm run build -w @slicer-hub/reporting && npm run build -w @slicer-hub/classroom && npm run build -w @slicer-hub/metaquest && npm run build -w @slicer-hub/ohif-extension
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @slicer-hub/client && npm run build -w @slicer-hub/worklist && npm run build -w @slicer-hub/reporting && npm run build -w @slicer-hub/classroom
scripts.serve:worklist: npm run build -w @slicer-hub/worklist && npm run serve -w @slicer-hub/worklist
scripts.serve:reporting: npm run build -w @slicer-hub/reporting && npm run serve -w @slicer-hub/reporting
scripts.serve:classroom: npm run build -w @slicer-hub/classroom && npm run serve -w @slicer-hub/classroom
